releaseNotes: Fixed syntax highlighting for ordinary source files whose diffs exceed 120 rows.
Unified Rift chats with native Claude Code and OpenCode sessions, including repository-wide persistence and automatic refresh after external changes.
Expanded native provider session discovery to the 100 most recent repository conversations and improved Claude title detection.
Named new Claude Code sessions so they are easier to find and resume from Claude's native session picker.
Added complete Claude model names and exact resolved model identifiers throughout reviews, chats, history, and model selection.
